api/shared/event_deliveries.py.name: Event retry rules
api/shared/event_deliveries.py.description: Says whether a failed event delivery may be sent again by hand.

api/shared/event_emission.py.name: Sending topic events
api/shared/event_emission.py.description: Checks the sender may post to a topic, then records the event so interested workflows can pick it up.

api/shared/event_filters.py.name: Event filter checks
api/shared/event_filters.py.description: Tests each event against a subscription's filter so only matching events are delivered.

api/shared/execution_context.py.name: Child run identity
api/shared/execution_context.py.description: Checks that work started by a parent run has a usable identity before it is allowed to continue.

api/shared/execution_liveness.py.name: Is the run alive
api/shared/execution_liveness.py.description: Answers whether a run is still in progress, so anyone waiting stops waiting at the right moment.

api/shared/execution_timeseries.py.name: Run activity chart
api/shared/execution_timeseries.py.description: Counts finished runs into time buckets for the dashboard chart without loading every run.

api/shared/execution_visibility.py.name: Who sees which run
api/shared/execution_visibility.py.description: Limits run lists and run details to the runs a person started themselves.

api/shared/run_cancellation.py.name: Cancelling waiting runs
api/shared/run_cancellation.py.description: Stops runs that were queued but never started, and marks a run as taken just before a worker picks it up.

api/shared/run_lineage.py.name: Who a run is for
api/shared/run_lineage.py.description: Records once, where a run starts, which person or stand-in it acts for, and passes that down to child runs.

api/shared/runtime_io.py.name: Live logs and service control
api/shared/runtime_io.py.description: Keeps a run's log lines on its own stream for reading back, and reports whether a long-running service should keep going.

api/shared/subprocess_env.py.name: Clean tool settings
api/shared/subprocess_env.py.description: Gives package-install tools a predictable set of settings so outside libraries install the same way every time.

api/shared/unattended_execution.py.name: Scheduled run identity
api/shared/unattended_execution.py.description: Builds the context for work no person started, using the chosen stand-in account for anything it does.

api/shared/usage_reporting.py.name: Daily usage report
api/shared/usage_reporting.py.description: Sends one anonymous daily count of workflow and agent runs so the product team can see adoption.
